card.title: JAGDPANTHER
card.flavorText: Jagdpanther (meaning "hunting panther" in German) was a German tank destroyer. The G2 variant was first produced in 1945 and used until the end of WWII, both on the Eastern and Western Fronts. The tank destroyer had a crew of 5, a main armament of 1x 8.8 cm Pak 43/3 or 43/4 L/71 and a secondary armament of 1x 7.92 mm Maschinengewehr 34. Only 415 Jagdpanther's were produced and placed into service.
